implicit-tangents.alt: The tilted oval x squared plus xy plus y squared = 3, with dy/dx = -(2x + y)/(x + 2y). Horizontal tangent lines touch it at (-1, 2) and (1, -2), where the numerator 2x + y is zero; vertical tangent lines touch it at (-2, 1) and (2, -1), where the denominator x + 2y is zero and the numerator is not.
